name: matma
description: Trygonometria — PWA + WebView (Android). Katalog główny to źródło wersji web, android/app/src/main/assets/www to kopia wklejana do APK.

scripts.sync:www: cp index.html manifest.json icon.svg android/app/src/main/assets/www/ && cp -r css js assets android/app/src/main/assets/www/
scripts.sync:root: cp android/app/src/main/assets/www/index.html android/app/src/main/assets/www/manifest.json android/app/src/main/assets/www/icon.svg . && cp -r android/app/src/main/assets/www/css android/app/src/main/assets/www/js android/app/src/main/assets/www/assets .
